mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE: conservative affinity updates with optional single CHIM relationship-type judgments from identity-checked NPC acknowledgements and Player-origin input, actor-owned reflection, default-off NPC ACK overhearing for the addressed listener plus up to four eligible roster listeners, CHIM-canonical Player handling, reserved rechat-sentinel exclusion, and a read-only dashboard. Derived Vampire and Black aliases are excluded while exact full catalog names remain eligible, as do personal aliases such as Bruce for Bruce Wayne; other common-word/name ambiguities remain. The experimental topic-discovery asset requires a newer CHIM manager and a standard (non-prerelease) GitHub release for discovery; its install and gameplay remain unverified. The package remains labeled BETA CANDIDATE, and the alias fix has isolated PHP coverage only.
